svg.title: ForeDance — four-panel editable overview
svg.desc: Native editable text, shapes, arrows and symbols; transparent robot illustrations derived from one master and one human illustration. The existing transparent official Magenta application icon is embedded. Robot drawings are schematic and are not hardware evidence.

svg.title: MuRoDance
svg.desc: Editable wordmark retaining the black and blue title colors.

H8 preview: 8 token pairs / 16 frames planned; 4 pairs / 8 frames committed. Paired history/state replacement, fixed recorded target encodings. Colors on the robot indicate supervision scope; both decoder paths produce full motions with shared boundary conditioning.

Execution robot illustrations: model renderings of frames 420 and 540 (7 s and 9 s) from the same 60 Hz G1 Gangnam Style reference sequence; not hardware experiment photographs. Every motion cell represents one frame. H8: 8 latent steps / 16 motion frames planned, 4 latent steps / 8 motion frames committed.
